As a result of this, they can create arcs of Electricity that can cause [[Link]] to drop metal [[Weapon]]s, [[Bow]]s, or [[Shield]]s. Electric Lizalfos typically reside in deserts, such as the [[Gerudo Desert]]. Striking their horns with an [[Arrow]] causes an Electric discharge. Like all Lizalfos, Electric Lizalfos will not attack [[Link]] if he is wearing the [[Lizalfos Mask]]. Defeated Electric Lizalfos will drop [[Lizalfos Horn]]s, [[Lizalfos Talon]]s, and [[Yellow Lizalfos Tail]]s. ====Drops==== {{Collapsible |header= Drops of Electric Lizalfos |collapse= true |content= {{Tabs |- | Normal | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Yellow Lizalfos Tail | 1 | 100 % |- | Lizalfos Talon | 2 | 100 % |- | Lizalfos Horn | 1 | 100 % }} |- | ElectricArrow | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Shock Arrow x5 | 1 | 50 % |- | Yellow Lizalfos Tail | 1 | 50 % |- | Lizalfos Horn | 1
